episodes.title: The Ship With No Crew
episodes.description: A ship crashes into Whitby with a dead captain tied to the wheel and no crew at all.

scenes.narration: The ship crashed into the harbour with a dead man tied to the wheel.
scenes.visual: A dead sea captain lashed to a ship's wheel in a raging storm, a crucifix bound in his hands

scenes.narration: Not one sailor was left on board.
scenes.visual: The empty deck of a ship in pouring rain

scenes.narration: As it hit the shore, a huge black dog leapt from the deck.
scenes.visual: A huge black dog leaping from a ship's bow onto a beach at night

scenes.narration: It raced up to the clifftop graveyard, and vanished.
scenes.visual: A dark dog bounding up stone steps toward a clifftop churchyard

scenes.narration: The captain's log told a nightmare.
scenes.visual: An open water-stained logbook beside a candle

scenes.narration: Night after night, another sailor disappeared.
scenes.visual: A lone sailor on watch in fog, a tall dark shape standing behind him

scenes.narration: The crew swore a tall, thin stranger was walking the deck.
scenes.visual: A tall thin silhouette standing on a foggy ship's deck at night

scenes.narration: The captain tied himself to the wheel with a crucifix, so it couldn't take him.
scenes.visual: A desperate captain tying his hands to the wheel during a storm

scenes.narration: The only cargo: fifty boxes of earth.
scenes.visual: Rows of wooden crates in a dark ship's hold

scenes.narration: The Count had arrived. In Part 7, he finds Lucy.
scenes.visual: A dark silhouette with red eyes on a clifftop above the town

episodes.title: Something on the Bench
episodes.description: Mina follows a sleepwalking Lucy into a graveyard, and sees something bent over her throat.

scenes.narration: Something was bent over Lucy's throat. And it lifted a face with red eyes.
scenes.visual: A long dark figure bending over a woman in white on a graveyard bench, red eyes glowing

scenes.narration: Minutes earlier, Mina had woken to find Lucy's bed empty.
scenes.visual: Mina waking in a dark bedroom, staring at an empty bed

scenes.narration: The bedroom door was wide open.
scenes.visual: An open bedroom door, moonlight spilling into the hallway

scenes.narration: Mina ran through the dark streets to the clifftop graveyard.
scenes.visual: Mina in a shawl running through cobbled night streets toward a ruined abbey

scenes.narration: There, on their favourite bench, lay a white figure.
scenes.visual: A figure in white lying on a bench in a moonlit graveyard

scenes.narration: And something dark was leaning over her.
scenes.visual: A long dark shape bending over a bench, silhouetted against the moon

scenes.narration: When Mina reached the bench, Lucy was alone. And ice cold.
scenes.visual: Mina wrapping her shawl around a sleeping Lucy on the bench

scenes.narration: On her throat were two tiny red marks.
scenes.visual: Close-up of two small puncture marks on a pale throat

scenes.narration: Mina told herself it was a pin.
scenes.visual: Mina frowning at a safety pin in her hand by candlelight

scenes.narration: It wasn't. In Part 8, a madman starts calling for his Master.
scenes.visual: The ruined abbey on the cliff under a blood-red moon

episodes.title: The Man Who Eats Flies
episodes.description: An asylum patient eats living things, and senses his Master moving in next door.

scenes.narration: He eats flies. Then spiders. Then birds. Alive.
scenes.visual: A wild-eyed man in a cell holding a sparrow, flies on the barred window

scenes.narration: His name is Renfield, a patient in Dr. Seward's asylum near London.
scenes.visual: A gloomy Victorian asylum beside a walled estate at dusk

scenes.narration: He believes every life he eats makes him stronger.
scenes.visual: Renfield grinning, holding a jar of crawling insects

scenes.narration: Lately, he stares for hours at the empty house next door.
scenes.visual: Renfield pressed against the bars, staring at a ruined mansion beyond the wall

scenes.narration: And he whispers: the Master is at hand.
scenes.visual: Close-up of Renfield's face grinning in the dark

scenes.narration: Dr. Seward has no idea what he means.
scenes.visual: Seward writing notes in his study by lamplight, troubled

scenes.narration: Far away, Mina finally hears from Jonathan. He's alive, in a hospital in Budapest.
scenes.visual: Mina reading a letter with tears of relief

scenes.narration: He escaped the castle, but his mind is shattered.
scenes.visual: Jonathan pale and thin in a hospital bed, tended by nuns

scenes.narration: Mina marries him right there, at his bedside.
scenes.visual: Mina holding Jonathan's hand at a bedside wedding with a priest

scenes.narration: But back in London, Lucy is dying. In Part 9, a professor finds out why.
scenes.visual: Lucy pale in bed in a dark Victorian bedroom

episodes.title: The Professor's Warning
episodes.description: Lucy loses blood every night, and only one man suspects where it's going.

scenes.narration: Lucy is losing blood every night, and nobody knows where it's going.
scenes.visual: Lucy deathly pale in bed in a Victorian bedroom, Arthur holding her hand

scenes.narration: Dr. Seward sends for his old teacher in Amsterdam, Professor Van Helsing.
scenes.visual: An elderly professor with a doctor's bag arriving at a London townhouse at night

scenes.narration: Van Helsing looks at her throat, and goes silent.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing examining Lucy's throat with a magnifying glass

scenes.narration: He orders a blood transfusion. Now.
scenes.visual: Seward and Van Helsing exchanging grave looks beside the bed

scenes.narration: Arthur gives his own blood to save the woman he loves.
scenes.visual: Arthur lying beside Lucy's bed during a Victorian blood transfusion

scenes.narration: Then Van Helsing does something strange.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing opening a box of white garlic flowers

scenes.narration: He fills her room with garlic flowers, and makes everyone swear not to touch them.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing hanging wreaths of white garlic flowers around a window

scenes.narration: He won't say why.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing raising a stern finger in warning in a dim bedroom

scenes.narration: That night, Lucy's mother can't stand the smell.
scenes.visual: An elderly lady in a nightcap frowning at the garlic flowers

scenes.narration: She opens the window, and throws the garlic out. In Part 10, something comes through that window.
scenes.visual: An open window at night, garlic flowers scattered on the floor, curtains blowing

episodes.title: That Wasn't Lucy
episodes.description: Lucy begs Arthur for one last kiss, in a voice that isn't hers.

scenes.narration: Lucy begs Arthur to kiss her, in a voice that isn't hers.
scenes.visual: Lucy reaching up toward Arthur with half-closed eyes, sharp teeth glinting

scenes.narration: Days earlier, a huge grey wolf smashed through her window.
scenes.visual: A great grey wolf crashing through a bedroom window in a shower of glass

scenes.narration: Her mother died of fright.
scenes.visual: An overturned candle and torn curtains in a dark bedroom

scenes.narration: Lucy was left alone with it until dawn.
scenes.visual: Lucy alone in a moonlit room with torn curtains, tears on her face

scenes.narration: Now she's dying. And she's changing.
scenes.visual: Lucy lying in bed, deathly pale, lips slightly parted

scenes.narration: Her teeth are longer. Sharper.
scenes.visual: Close-up of sharp teeth behind pale lips

scenes.narration: Arthur leans in to kiss her goodbye.
scenes.visual: Arthur leaning toward Lucy's face in candlelight

scenes.narration: Van Helsing hurls him back with shocking strength.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing seizing Arthur's arm and pulling him away from the bed

scenes.narration: Moments later, Lucy dies.
scenes.visual: Lucy lying still in bed surrounded by candles

scenes.narration: But Van Helsing whispers: this is only the beginning. In Part 11, children start vanishing.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing speaking quietly to Seward in a dim hallway, faces grave
